guard.note: listResources: for each delegate (delegates.iterator()), delegate.listResources(type, namespace, path, output)
delegates = an immutable copy; namespacesAssets / namespacesData built from it
namespace -> delegates that declare it (getNamespaces), in delegate order
the map choice the switch repeats: namespacesAssets for client resources, namespacesData otherwise
a mod-file pack's listing: decomposePath, then listPath under resolve(type, namespace), or an error log for an invalid path
the listPath call, rooted at resolve(type directory, namespace)
every directory directly under the type folder; data falls back to the asset namespaces (adds only)
a mod-file pack is the anonymous ResourcePackLoader$1 the switch recognises
listPath: files found under the resolved folder; a missing folder is a silently caught NoSuchFileException
decomposePath: the path test the switch repeats before skipping any delegate
resolvePath: listPath's folder stays under the namespace folder

forge_mod_resources_namespace_index.conversion: Client only (config list "client"): Forge builds the mod_resources DelegatingPackResources only for client resource packs (ClientModLoader); a dedicated or integrated server registers every mod file as its own data pack "mod:<id>" (ServerLifecycleHooks.serverPackFinder) and never lists mod_resources. MixinExtras @WrapOperation (priority 1500, require = 0) on the delegates.iterator() call in DelegatingPackResources.listResources (m_8031_): an iterator over Forge's own namespace -> delegates list (namespacesAssets / namespacesData, as getCandidatePacks) when every delegate is a Forge mod-file pack (ResourcePackLoader$1), the namespace is in the map and FileUtil.decomposePath accepts the path; the original iterator otherwise (other DelegatingPackResources, e.g. TACZ's gun packs and Kiwi's, keep Forge's loop: one DEBUG line per class). Helper bons.furious.patch.forge_mod_resources_index.ModResourcesIndex; Neighbours steps aside when another mod's untested mixin is applied to Forge's PathPackResources, ResourcePackLoader(1), vanilla's PathPackResources or DelegatingPackResources. Shadow mode -Dbons_and_furious.modResourcesNamespaceIndex.shadow=true. Our TrackworkResources @ModifyVariable on the same method is untouched.
forge_mod_resources_namespace_index.license: Forge (LGPL-2.1) and Minecraft (Mojang): no code of either is carried; the loop iterates Forge's own candidate list (helpers bons.furious.patch.forge_mod_resources_index.ModResourcesIndex and Neighbours)
